method.boot: runProfile() from apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:244, awaited until the profile settles
method.home: fresh mkdtemp per case; DSH_HOME points at it; the live shell home is never read or written
method.rows: inserted into <home>/profiles/r21probe/cordis.patch.yml; each row names a local module written beside the patch file
method.observation: each module appends one JSON line per lifecycle event (apply/dispose) to a marker file
method.calibration: every case also inserts a calibration row that must mount; without it, "the row did not mount" and "the boot never got there" are the same reading
